complexity.notes: Correct but more convoluted than needed: the base-case check, peeling off the head, and the post-loop fixup all disappear with the standard prev/curr loop that initializes prev to None and runs the rewiring inside the while body. That rewrite is purely cosmetic, same O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.summary: Iterative in-place reversal: walks the list once, rewiring each node's next pointer to its predecessor and returning the final node as the new head.
